units.source_text: 催马乐《河口》歌词：“河口有个关，关门是疏栏。

en.t: The lyrics to the saibara song Kawaguchi say: At Kawaguchi there is a barrier, and its gate is a sparse fence.

units.source_text: 虽然是疏栏，关吏守得严。

en.t: Although it is only a sparse fence, the barrier guards watch it strictly.

units.source_text: 虽然守得严，被我逃出关。

en.t: Although they watch it strictly, I slipped out through the barrier.

units.source_text: 出关会情人，两人同衾眠。”

en.t: Once beyond the barrier, I meet my lover, and the two of us sleep beneath the same quilt.
The Kawaguchi barrier was in Ise District.

units.source_text: 夕雾欲唱此歌，意思是说：内大臣虽然管得严，他俩早已私通。

en.t: Yugiri wanted to sing this song to imply that, although the Minister of the Interior kept strict control, the two of them had already been secretly involved.
This is why the following passage goes on to mention Kumoi no Kari's poem and so forth.
